back_translation: The righteous person perishes, and no one takes it to heart; people of steadfast love are taken away, with no one understanding that the righteous person is taken away to be spared from the evil.
He enters into peace; those who walk in uprightness rest on their beds of death.
"But you all, come near here, you children of a sorceress, you offspring of an adulterer and a prostitute.
Whom are you mocking? At whom do you open wide your mouth and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of deceit?
You who burn with lust among the oaks, under every lush tree; who slaughter your children in the ravines, under the clefts of the crags.
Your portion is among the smooth stones of the ravine; they, they are your allotted lot. To them you have poured out drink offerings and presented grain offerings. Should I relent over these things?
You have set your bed on a high and lofty mountain, and you went up there to offer sacrifice.

You set your symbol behind the door and the doorpost; you abandoned me and uncovered your bed; you went up on it and opened it wide. You made a pact with those whose bed you love, and you gazed on their nakedness.
You journeyed to Molech with oil and multiplied your perfumes; you sent your envoys far away, and sent down even to the realm of the dead.
You were wearied by the length of your way, but you never said, 'It is hopeless.' You found your strength renewed; therefore you did not grow faint.
Whom did you fear and dread, that you lied and did not remember me or take it to heart? Is it not because I have kept silent so long that you do not fear me?
I will declare your righteousness and your deeds — but they will be of no benefit to you.

When you cry for help, let your collection of idols deliver you! The wind will carry them all off; a single breath will sweep them away. But the one who takes refuge in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain."
And it will be said: "Build up, build up the road! Prepare the way! Remove every obstacle from the way of my people."

For the One who is high and exalted, who dwells forever, whose name is Holy, says this: "I dwell in a high and holy place, but also with the crushed and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the crushed.
For I will not accuse forever, nor will I always be angry; otherwise the spirit of man would faint before me — the breaths of life that I have made.
I was angry because of the iniquity of his unjust gain; I struck him, I hid my face and was angry — yet he kept turning back to the way of his own heart.
I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comfort to him and to his mourners,
creating the fruit of lips: Peace, peace to the one far away and to the one near," says the LORD, "and I will heal him."
But the wicked are like the churning sea, which cannot be still, and its waters stir up mire and mud.
"There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."
